title: Q-LESSON-no-date-bombs: enforce the lesson in code
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** lesson `no-date-bombs` in doctrine/lessons.json has no enforcing code
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation lessons --probe no-date-bombs
**Status:** closed

LESSONS-1: add a check that fails on a hard-coded future date or expiry in code that a loop does not move. Then add the binding to the lesson in doctrine/lessons.json and close this item.

**Prediction:** date_bombs <= 0 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** compatibility dates moved by foundation/compatdate.py.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation lessons --probe no-date-bombs` exits 0 on main. It exits 1 today: no binding in doctrine/lessons.json enforces the lesson.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T21:02:14Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-26T02:04:56Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: workers-ai-glm: HTTPError: HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized | github-models-gpt: RuntimeError: non-JSON re. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-26T22:51:59Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: lessons ok: 9 of 13 enforced in code; the rest each have an open item

**Evidence:** 2026-11-26T23:10:00Z the fixed verdict of 22:51:59Z is reverted: its done check was `lessons --check`, which passes exactly while this item is held, so the pass did not show the lesson enforced, and closing the item on it turned `lessons --check` red on main. The done check is now `lessons --probe no-date-bombs`, which fails until a binding lands; `lessons --check` refuses any lesson item that closes on another probe.
